description: List events awaiting approval in a community you run — who submitted, when, whether they asked for your community payout, and any requested venue Space slot with its conflicts (hard = confirmed overlap, approval will fail; soft = competing pending request, first approval wins). Approve with approve_community_event — except payout-routing submissions, which are reviewed in the studio (link returned); decline with reject_community_event. Requires community_id. Read-only.
name: list_pending_community_events
title: List Pending Community Events
